## Samsung Displays HBM4 Sixth-Generation AI Memory at Korea Tech Festival

Samsung's active HBM4 showcase signals its intent to compete in next-generation AI memory; the key PM watch is whether Samsung closes the qualification gap with SK Hynix in time to capture share in the next HBM upcycle rather than concede another generation.

- Samsung Electronics showcased its HBM4 product — described in the headline as a sixth-generation high-bandwidth memory solution — at the Korea Tech Festival.
- The product is positioned for AI and HPC applications per the headline.
- This is a product display event, not an announced customer win or shipment milestone.
- The Korea Tech Festival referenced in the headline is dated 2025.
